lines.text: The son must bind loving devotion and faithfulness around his neck and write them on the doorposts of his house.
The son is told to honor the LORD with his wealth, and then his barns will be filled with silver.

problems.problem: It has 21 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
Its true detail "tablet of his heart" isn't in Proverbs 3:3 word for word.
Its wrong detail "stone tablets of the ark" is 5 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
Its wrong detail "filled with manna" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
